source_refs.note: 3. Polysaccharides: a main subheading of 27.1 Carbohydrates, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 161-163.

blocks.text: Polysaccharides bare molecules hain jo bohat se monosaccharide units ke jurne se bante hain. In ka molecular mass zyada hota hai aur general formula (C₆H₁₀O₅)ₙ hai. Hydrolysis par yeh saada sugars, yani monosaccharides, dete hain. Aam misalein starch, glycogen, cellulose aur pectin hain. Starch paudon mein energy ka main storage (zakheera) hai aur glucose units se bana hai. Is ke do hisse hain: amylose aur amylopectin.

Amylose ki lambi chains hain jin mein branches (shaakhein) nahi hotin aur bohat se glycosidic linkages hote hain. Amylopectin aik compact (gathi hui) aur highly branched (bohat shaakhon wali) structure hai jo bohat se glucose units se bani hai (Figure 27.3). Kitab ke mutabiq amylopectin paani mein ghulta hai aur amylose nahi ghulta. Aaloo, sugar beet (chukandar), chawal aur anaaj mein bohat starch hota hai.

Cellulose paudon ki cell walls ka main structural material (dhaancha banane wala maadda) hai. Yeh kai sau se le kar taqreeban 10,000 glucose units ki lambi, unbranched (be-shaakh) chains hain jo glycosidic bonds se juri hain (Figure 27.3). Yeh chains aapas mein mazboot hydrogen bonds banati hain, is liye cellulose rigid (sakht) hai aur paani mein nahi ghulta. Paudon ke patte, shaakhein aur tana zyada tar isi se bane hain. Insani khurak mein yeh fibre (resha) ki shakal mein bohat ahem hai aur gut (aanton) ki sehat behtar karta hai. Glycogen, jise animal starch bhi kehte hain, glucose ka polymer hai jo jaanwaron ke liver (jigar) aur muscles mein jama hota hai. Is ki structure amylopectin jaisi hai, lekin is mein branches aur bhi zyada hain; yahi cheez ise starch se alag karti hai. Kitab yeh bhi kehti hai ke glycogen mein amylopectin wali structure nahi hoti.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke cellulose mein “2500 tak” glucose units hote hain. Asal mein cellulose ki chains kai sau se le kar taqreeban 10,000 glucose units tak lambi hoti hain (cotton aur paudon ke reshe), is liye 2500 ki had kam hai.

blocks.alt: a) Amylose: teen glucose rings C1-O-C4 se jure, har link par alpha-link (C1-C4), 1,4 glycosidic linkage. b) Amylopectin: glucose rings ki do rows (qataarein) C1-O-C4 se jureen, aur aik branch (shaakh) jahan oopar wale ring ka C1 O ke zariye neeche wale ring ke CH2 (C6) se jura hai, 1,6 glycosidic linkage. c) Cellulose: teen glucose rings, carbons C likh kar, beta links se O ke zariye jure.
blocks.caption: Figure 27.3: a) Amylose, b) starch mein amylopectin aur c) cellulose ki banawat (kitab ki Figure 27.3 ke mutabiq hamari drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Amylose aur amylopectin mein glucose ke C1 ki oxygen neeche (alpha) hai aur agle glucose ke C4 se judti hai (1,4 link). Amylopectin mein kuch jagah C1 agle glucose ke C6 (CH₂) se judta hai: yahi 1,6 link shaakh (branch) banata hai. Cellulose mein link beta hai (C1 ki oxygen oopar).

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Figure 27.3 mein kitab ne 'a-Link' chhapa hai; sahi 'α-link' (alpha-link) hai. '(1,4 Glyocosidic Inkage)' asal mein '1,4 glycosidic linkage' hai, aur 'Ch₂' asal mein CH₂ hai. Hamari drawing mein sahi likha gaya hai.

items: Monosaccharides: glucose (aldose), fructose (ketose); solution mein zyada tar ring ki shakal.
Disaccharides (sucrose, lactose, maltose): do units glycosidic link (C–O–C) se, condensation mein paani nikalta hai.
